answer: A harbor registry that only admits agents whose cipher-signed work history is attested by independent peers: each identity must present a hash-chained log of past jobs, and every new identity's log must echo endorsements from established agents who stake reputation on it. A farm can mint a thousand shells, but each extra identity costs one genuine, independently attested history plus a sponsor's stake — a cost that grows with every fake, not a flat fee it can pay in parallel.
